claims.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate banks with active cross block C of exact rank r>=3 and nonzero singular-value product Pi_r(C), arbitrary self terms/outside couplings and independent cap-one laws give a bounded continuous density with ||p_Q||_inf <= e*r/(r-2)*Pi_r(C)^(-1/r). If one active bank has exactly r physical coordinates the e factor improves to sqrt(e); if both are physical r-banks, ||p_Q||_inf <= r/(r-2)|det C|^(-1/r).
For disjoint physical triples I,J, det A[I,J]!=0 implies ||p_Q||_inf <= 3|det A[I,J]|^(-1/3), with arbitrary outside spectrum/couplings and cap-one laws.
In the fleet03/B07 O0 alternative e3(BB^T)>=1/256, if rank(B)=3 then ||p_Q||_inf <= 3e*16^(1/3)<20.549.
For the fleet01/B07 heavy-core factorization with |T|=r in {3,4}, either residual regularized determinant D_res>M or the physical core is paid by sqrt(e)*r/(r-2)*gamma^(-1)*(4sqrt(M)/e^(3/2))^(1/r).

dependencies.use: r-dimensional projection-density cap exp(r/2) in the rectangular exact-rank theorem
no-loss transfer of the new physical-cross interval inequality from finite-union cores to arbitrary cap-one product densities

first_unpaid_detail: Pay |T|<=2 or large-D_res/small-gamma heavy O0 states by coupling at most two physical heavy directions to a residual ridge/grouped bank, forcing a third source-realizable mixed direction or an already-paid branch. O1/O2/O3 aggregate payments remain subsequent obligations.
